now

updated sep 2026. what i'm doing instead of assignments.

building Beyond Search

main quest: Beyond Search. side quest: degree. both behind schedule.

currently breaking my own benchmark daily: about 50 queries, 3 models, watching which phrasing makes models switch favorites. if you want your product to actually get mentioned, yell at me.

current obsessions

  • agents that finish the job. research, draft, follow up, no babysitting. the dream is software that closes loops while i nap.
  • AEO and GEO. rephrasing the same query ten ways to watch models switch favorites. yes, i argue with phrasing for fun.
  • typography at 2am. kern, regret, repeat. spacing opinions nobody asked for.
  • posting until someone cares. the distribution arc. LinkedIn without the cringe, x without the doom. jury is out.
  • Chinese food logistics. optimal reorder timing is a real discipline. current research is delicious.
  • degree (allegedly). finishing coursework while shipping irl. both slow. both help.

things i don't know yet

  • no clue what company i'll be running in five years.
  • no clue if answer engines stay apps or melt into the browser.
  • no clue which of my citation guesses survive eighteen months.
  • fine with that. asking users is better than having a plan.

young, ambitious, underqualified, shipping anyway. trying to be in the middle of where tech goes next instead of live tweeting it from the sidelines.
